title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction From Leaf Tissue
author: Patricia Lu-Irving
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bu9ynz7w

steps.title: Prepare reagents
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8 to 50 °C and make fresh 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Grind ~2 g leaf material in a mortar and pestle under liquid nitrogen to a fine powder, keep frozen and transfer to 15 mL tubes.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL pre‑warmed extraction buffer containing β‑mercaptoethanol to each tube and resuspend the powder by inverting/tapping.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹) to each tube and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 65 °C for 1–1.5 h, inverting every 10–20 min.

steps.title: Cool tubes
steps.instruction: Allow tubes to cool for at least 5 min.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube and mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge first extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 000 × g, room temperature, for 20 min.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA (step 1)
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube, record the volume, add an equal volume of room‑temperature isopropanol and mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitation 1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 20 min.

steps.title: Second chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the pellet, mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min, gently inverting periodically.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase (post‑RNase)
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube and record the volume transferred.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑RNase
steps.instruction: Spin at 3 000 × g, room temperature, for 20 min.

steps.title: Third chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL sorbitol wash containing β‑mercaptoethanol, mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add 1 × volume washed magnetic beads to 1 × volume DNA solution.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate 10 min at room temperature, gently inverting the tubes periodically.

steps.title: Collect beads
steps.instruction: Touch‑spin briefly in a desktop centrifuge to bring the bead suspension to the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Magnet separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and wait until the bead pellet forms on the side of the tube.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol and slowly rotate the tube 360° in the magnet rack to wash the bead pellet.

steps.title: Discard ethanol (wash 1)
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the 1 mL 70 % ethanol wash (steps above) once more.

steps.title: Final ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Touch‑spin to collect residual ethanol, then pipette off the residual ethanol being careful not to disturb the bead pellet.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to dry briefly (less than 1 min).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50–100 µL pre‑heated (50 °C) 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8, incubate at least 10 min at room temperature to elute; if elution is difficult, incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Separate eluate
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack, wait for the bead pellet to reform, then transfer the supernatant (eluted DNA) to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA quantity with Qubit and assess purity (OD260/280, OD260/230) and integrity by agarose‑gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining bead pellet in 100 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and allow the pellet to air‑dry on the bench (do not over‑dry).

steps.title: High‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 20 min.

steps.title: First 77 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 1.5 mL 77 % ethanol, gently dislodge the pellet by inverting/tapping, and place the tube in a refrigerator for 20 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge after first ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 20 min.

steps.title: Second 77 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 1.5 mL ice‑cold 77 % ethanol, gently dislodge the pellet, and leave the tube in the refrigerator overnight.

steps.title: Centrifuge after second ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 20 min.

steps.title: Third 77 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL ice‑cold 77 % ethanol, dislodge the pellet, pour the ethanol + pellet into a new 1.5 mL tube, and refrigerate for 20 min.

steps.title: Final ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, pipette off residual isopropanol, and allow the pellet to air‑dry on the bench (do not over‑dry).

steps.title: Low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 30 min.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube, record the volume, add an equal volume of room‑temperature isopropanol, and mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitation 2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 20 min.

steps.title: Final chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Second RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min, gently inverting periodically.

steps.title: Final aqueous transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube and record the volume transferred.

steps.title: Final spin
steps.instruction: Spin at 3 000 × g, room temperature, for 20 min.

steps.title: Final chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and mix by inversion for 2 min.
